content_digest_definition: sha256 over UTF-8 newline-joined compact JSON arrays, one per row, columns in the schema order below, rows ordered by observation_id, timestamps ISO-8601, nulls as null. Writer-independent: it survives a parquet library upgrade that the file digest does not.

parquet_writer.note: The parquet footer carries the writer's own created_by string, so the file digest is reproducible only under the recorded writer version. content_sha256 is the digest to re-derive against.

source_run_binding: NONE. source_run_id is NULL for all 654 rows and there is no authoritative row-to-run binding (issue #355): the platform exposes no row-level run id in the fetcher tables, so the runs that produced these values cannot be named. No run id is inferred from timestamps or from observations.source_runs, and none is invented here.
immutability: Immutable. These bytes are the single preserved baseline snapshot required by data-architecture.md section 18 for the temporary full-refresh period. product_adoption_current is full-refresh, so every later run overwrites the state these bytes record; nothing may rewrite, refresh or relabel this file.
captured_at_note: UTC instant the SELECT against the deployed product_adoption_current returned.
